response.overview: There is no more fascinating story than that of the Neanderthals, the other human species that shared the territory with our own for thousands of years. In the Lozoya River Valley, in the heart of the Iberian Peninsula, lies an enigma that challenges our perception of the past: a hidden sanctuary, a collection of skulls of large mammals deliberately arranged in a cave. Beyond hunting and survival, the Neanderthals left behind evidence of something profoundly human: the need to give meaning to their world. Each new piece of evidence brings us closer to a revelation: perhaps humanity did not begin with us, but was shared with those who came before us. A search for answers that ultimately confronts us with our own reflection in the mirror of time.
response.title: The Neanderthals' Valley
